topic_rules: Start with a simple What If question.
Prefer topics that a 12-year-old and an adult can both understand immediately.
Create a strong visual transformation in the first scene.
Build consequences scene by scene and end with a surprising payoff.
Prefer human-scale or planet-scale stakes over abstract science.
Do not repeat the same core phenomenon within the recent topic history.
Favor evergreen curiosity topics; use current trends only when they naturally fit the science niche.
Never sacrifice scientific plausibility just to chase a trend.

learning_rules.decision_rule: After enough data, shift more topics toward the lanes and slots that consistently outperform the channel median, while keeping controlled experiments running.
learning_rules.minimum_experiment: Do not change the whole strategy after one viral or weak Short; use repeated results across comparable videos.
